movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Used for climbing and balancing on the frame
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Used to maintain balance while suspended
movement_profile.posture: Upright during the climb; inverted during the descent

signature_moves.description: Falling backward from the frame while suspended by ropes to spin around the pole.
signature_moves.name: The Descent

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Do not attempt without professional training and traditional oversight.

music_profile.sound_description: The music consists of a flute and drum played by the caporal at the top of the pole, representing the sound of birds singing.

basic_steps: Ascend the pole to the platform
Secure the rope around the waist
teaching.formation: Circular formation around a central pole
teaching.level_notes: Requires extensive training; traditionally involves 10 to 12 years of preparation.
